weaknesses: The abstract overstates the generalizability of results, implying that all LLMs are equally vulnerable to cipher attacks without sufficient empirical evidence.
The paper lacks a thorough discussion on the limitations of the proposed methods, particularly regarding the applicability of ciphers in real-world scenarios.
The experimental setup does not adequately address potential biases in the selection of ciphers, which may skew the results.
strengths: The introduction of the CipherChat framework is a novel approach to exploring LLM vulnerabilities, contributing to the discourse on AI safety.
The empirical results provide compelling evidence that certain ciphers can effectively bypass safety mechanisms in LLMs, highlighting a significant area of concern.
The paper effectively combines theoretical insights with practical experimentation, demonstrating a clear understanding of the implications of LLM capabilities.
